drin la che chung med pas 'di tsam du phan 'dogs pa 'di bde na ci ma rung skyid na ci ma rung*/ ngas bde skyid mthar thug la 'god dgos snyam pa sogs gong bzhin bsgom/ de bzhin du rim gyis sbyar nas bsgom dgos te/ de la yang bshes gnyen bya yul ba dang*/ snar thang ba'i lugs kyis yul phyogs sogs re re nas bsnan kyin bsgom pa'i lugs yod de/ las dang po pa'i dmigs pa bsgom tshul la lugs 'di kho na gnad che bar mthong*/ de'i rjes nas rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs de'i mi'i 'gro ba dgra gnyen bar ma gsum/ dud 'gro sa 'og sa steng bar snang la spyod pa gsum/ yi dwags 'dre bkren yang mchog dman bar gsum ci tsam cig yod/ de thams cad skye ba dpag tu med pa'i pha dang ma yin pa dang*/ phan btags tshul dang drin du bzo ba dang byams pa bsgom pa gong bzhin sbyar/ de bzhin du rgyal khams rgya je che je cher bsnan te/ mthar rang re bod pa'i dbang du byas na bod ril bo tsam gyi 'gro ba rigs gsum la bsgom/ de nas de bzhin du bod gyi shar na rgya nag lho na rgya gar nub na kha che byang na hor dang stag gzig ste/ rgyal khams chen po de rnams la gnas pa'i 'gro ba rigs gsum la bsgom/ de nas 'dzam bu gling ril po'i 'gro ba rigs gsum la bsgom/ de nas 'dzam bu gling gi 'og na yi dwags kyi gnas dang*/ tsha dmyal brgyad dang grang dmyal brgyad kyi gnas yod de/ de rnams la sngar bzhin bsgom/ de bzhin du shar lus 'phags po dang*/ nub ba lang spyod dang*/ byang sgra mi snyan te gling bzhi la steng na gong bzhin 'gro ba rigs gsum gyis gang ba dang*/ 'og na ngan song gsum gyi 'gro ba sna tshogs dang bcas pa la yang gong bzhin ri rab kyi bang rim bzhi la rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lha yod/ rtse mo na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams yod/ ri rab kyi khong seng chu mtshams man chad na lha ma yin gyi gtso bo rnams gnas pa'i grong yod de dag na gnas pa la sngar bzhin bsgom/

de nas gser gyi ri bdun dang phyi lcags ri khor yug tshun chad la chu mtshams yan chad la lha dang*/ gnod sbyin dud 'gro'i 'gro ba dag gnas/ chu mtshams man chad lha min dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro sna tshogs rnams gnas/ de dag gi bar bar gyi rol mtsho bdun dang phyi'i rgya mtsho la klu dang lha ma yin dang dud 'gro'i 'gro ba phal pa go mtshams med pa tsam du gnas/ de thams cad la sngar bzhin bsgom/ dud 'gro'i nang na dud 'gro rdzu 'phrul can gsum yod de/ nam mkha' la spyod pa'i bya khyung*/ sa steng na spyod pa'i mi'am ci/ sa 'og gam chu la spyod pa'i klu rnams so/ /de dag la yang sgos su bsgom/ dmigs skor de yan chad kyis 'og dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi yan chod thad kar phyi lcags ri tshun chod/ steng du sum cu rtsa gsum man chad la bsgoms tshar/ de'i steng du mtha' bral dang*/ dga' ldan dang*/ 'phrul dga' dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed rnams rim pas bsnan te sngar bzhin bsgom/ de nas gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i tshangs ris/ tshangs pa mdun na 'don/ tshangs chen te bsam gtan dang po'i gnas gsum bsnan/ skabs 'dir 'di skad ces bya ste/ 'di nas bzung ste gzugs khams kyi gnas 'di kun na lha'i 'gro ba gzugs khams pa rang kho na ma gtogs/ 'gro ba gzhan lnga po gang yang med de/ lha 'dod khams pa yang med/ gnas so so rang rang gi lha kho na gnas pa yin/ spyir na tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na gnas pa'i/ 'gro ba rigs drug po thams cad la gong bzhin bsgom/ da ni de ka 'dra ba 'phred la stong phrag gcig gshibs pa'i mtha' lcags ri gcig gis bskor ba/ steng na 'od chung*/ tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal te bsam gtan gnyis pa'i gnas gsum yod pa'i nang nas/ 'od gsal ba'i gnas chen po gcig gis steng nas khebs pa ni stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams te/

de na gnas pa'i rigs drug la sngar bzhin bsgom/ da de de 'dra ba stong phrag gcig thad kar bsgrigs pa'i mtha' skor du/ slar yang khor yug gcig gis bskor te/ steng du ni dge chung dang*/ tshad med dge dang*/ dge rgyas te bsam gtan gsum pa'i gnas gsum yod la/ de kun gyi steng nas dge rgyas kyi gnas gcig gis khebs pa yin te/ stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi 'gro ba rigs drug la sngar bzhin bsgom/ yang de 'dra ba thad kar stong phrag gcig pa bsgrigs pa'i tha ma/ slar yang khor yug chen po gcig gis bskor/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re la 'og gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi re re yod/ de re re'i 'og na chu'i dkyil 'khor re re yod/ chu'i dkyil 'khor bye ba phrag brgya rlung gi dkyil 'khor gcig la brten/ 'og tu ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor yan chod/ steng du ni sprin med/ bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che ba ste bsam gtan bzhi ba'i gnas phal ba gsum/ de bzhin du mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ gya nom snang shin tu mthong*/ 'og min pa rnams bsnan/ 'og min pa'i gnas gcig po de steng nas stong gsum khebs/ de la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes zer/ gzugs med khams kyi sems can yang dpag tu med pa zhig yod pa de dag kyang bsnan te/ khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can rnams la gong bzhin bsgom mo/ /de nas yang stong gsum 'di'i shar phyogs na phar la stong gsum grangs med gzhal du med/ dper na stong gsum gcig yungs 'brus mer te bkang nas/ yungs 'bru de las gcig blangs te 'di'i shar phyogs kyi stong gsum gcig la bzhag /de bzhin du stong gsum re re la yungs 'bru re re bzhag na mthar yungs 'bru ni zad 'gro la shar phyogs kyi stong gsum mi zad do/ /yang de ka bzhin byas kyang yungs 'bru 'dzad stong gsum mi zad yang bskyar te byas kyang de dang 'dra/

de 'dra ba bskal pa mtha' med du byas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams la zad pa med/ de dag thams cad 'gro ba rigs drug gis gang ba yin te/ de thams cad la mar shes pa nas byams pa bsgom pa'i bar gong bzhin/ da ni shar phyogs su ma zad phyogs bcu rab 'byams thams cad kyang de dang 'dra ste phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' la mtha' gtan nas med/ nam mkhas gar khyab snod kyi 'jig rten gyis khyab/ sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha ma yin/ pha ma byas pa lan grangs dpag tu med/ byas res nas phan sna tshogs ni btags/ gnod pa sna tshogs ni bsal/ ma rgan sems can 'di rnams bde bar gyur cig skyid par gyur cig /bdag gis 'di rnams bde skyid bla na med pa la 'god par bya'o snyam du bsgom/ de rnams la nang tshan dmigs skor shin tu mang par 'gyur mod/ blo rigs dang bstun nas nges med du 'khrid dgos pas tshad kyi dbye ba cung zad dka' ba dang*/ byams pa'i sems rgya bskyed par rigs gcig pas dmigs chen gcig tu bsdus te/ dmigs skor so brgyad pa'i tha snyad byed do/ /skabs 'dir snod bcud 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag cig shes na gnad che'o/ /des byams pa'i khrid tshar ba lags// //gnyis pa snying rje bsgom pa ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ sems can 'di rnams bde zhing skyid pa la 'god dgos pa 'dug pa la sems can gyi khams la bltas na/ sems can 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu la mi gnas/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la gnas/ 'dod pa ni bde ba 'dod sdug bsngal mi 'dod kyang yong ba ni bde ba mi 'byung sdug bsngal kho na 'byung*/ phal cher ni sdug bsngal dngos la gnas/ dmyal ba na tsha grang*/ yi dwags na bkres skom/ dud 'gro na gcig la gcig za/ mtho ris na yang tshe thung ba dang*/ nad mang pa dang*/ dbang chung pa dang*/ bkren cing 'phongs pa dang*/ las la 'khol ba dang chad pas bcad pa sogs dngos su rang yang sdug bsngal 'di mi myong bya ba med pa der 'dug

/'gro ba thams cad spyir na sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dpag tu med pa la spyod pa de yin/ sgos su 'ga' zhig da lta rang mi 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal drag po ni med du chug kyang*/ sdig pa'i las rngam po che bsags pas dbugs kha gang bo 'gags pa dang mnyam du/ dmyal bar khrod khrod skye dgos pa 'di rnams dngos su da lta sdug bsngal myong ba rnams las kyang snying rje bar 'dug /snang ba re 'khrul na a tsa ma ci rang drag snyam du bsam/ dper na rang gi rtsa ba'i ma de mig ni long rkang pa ni chag long khrid ni med/ mkhar ba ni bor/ gad kha g.yang kha cig nas mar lhung la khad khad 'dug na bdag ci tsug byed/ gzhan gang la yang ma bltas par hab rgyugs su phyin nas ma de g.yang kha nas 'dzin dgos/ dpe de bzhin du ma rgan 'gro ba 'di rnams shes rab kyi mig ni long*/ thabs kyi rkang pa ni chag /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nam grogs bzang po'i long khrid ni med/ bsod nams kyi mkhar pa dang ni bral/ yid la dran du yang mi rung ba'i sdig pa thams cad ni lag len du yang yang btab/ mtho ris kyi lam nas brdeg 'chos te/ ngan song gsum gyi g.yang la lhung la khad khad pa sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi bzad pa la gnas pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ da ni 'di rnams ngas sdug bsngal las dngos su ma bskyab pa'i thabs med/ des na ngan song gsum na ni tshor ba sdug bsngal dngos la gtso bor spyod/ bde 'gro gsum na ni tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la gtso bor spyod/ de dag gi sdug bsngal skyes bu chung 'bring gi skabs su bshad pa ltar dran par bya/ sdug bsngal de bdag g-i thog tu babs na cha shas tsam yang bzod pa'i glags mi 'dug /bdag gis mi bzod pa zhig 'di rnams kyis kyang ga la bzod/ de 'dra ba'i sdug bsngal dngos su yang myong zhing*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu zad mi shes pa la rim gyis rim gyis spyad pas/ sdug bsngal nas sdug bsngal brgyud mar 'byung ba 'di rnams snying re rje/

'di rnams sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig / sdug bsngal gyi rgyu las dang nyon mongs thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /ma rgan 'gro drug gi sems can 'di rnams sdig pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad las bdag gi bskyab par bya/ sdug bsngal gyi gnas 'khor ba las 'dren par bya snyam du yang yang bsam/ dmigs skor so dgu pa'o// //yang na 'di la sdug bsngal dngos la spyod pa la dmigs skor gcig sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la spyod pa la dmigs skor gcig /gnyis ka bsdoms pa la gcig ste gsum byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ sngar byams pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin rim gyis thams cad rgya bskyed de bsgoms na yang legs par 'ong ngo*/ /yang byams snying rje'i khrid lan cig bskyangs pa'i rjes su 'di gnyis 'brel pa can kho na 'byung bas byams pa re la snying rje re mthud kyin bsgoms pas chog /tshan pa so sor ma bcad kyang rung ba lags so// //gsum pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ smon pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gnyis so/ /'di gnyis la bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab pa zhes zer ba'ang yod do/ /de'i dang po la byang chub kyi sems dngos la bslab pa/ phan yon dran pa la bslab pa/ bslab bya la dam 'cha' ba ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ sngar gyi byams snying rje gnyis dang 'brel bar bsgom ste/ ma 'di rnams bde dgos par 'dug /skyid dgos par 'dug pa la/ mi bde mi skyid sdug bsngal bar 'dug pa snying re rje/ bdag gis 'di rnams kyi sdug bsngal mi sel ba'i thabs med/ 'di rnams bde ba la mi 'god pa'i thabs med de/ 'on kyang de'i nus pa bdag la mi 'dug /der ma zad tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur rgyal rnams la'ang med/ 'o na su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod/ de lta na yang sangs rgyas de bsgrubs na thob yong ba yin pas bdag gis sangs rgyas thob par bya/

thob nas sems can 'khor ba las 'dren par bya/ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas thob dgos pa 'dug snyam pa yang yang bya/ dmigs skor bzhi bcu pa'o// //gong du dmigs skor so bzhi pa bsam pa'i 'jug sgo la bslab pa'i skabs su ni/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan shesashing theg pa che chung gi khyad par shes pa'i sgo nas rdzogs byang don gnyer tsam bsgom pa yin la/ de tsam gyis byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs par mi 'gyur zhing*/ 'dir gzhan don kho nar rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi bsam pa bsgoms pas smon pa byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid tshang bar 'gyur ro/ /gong du'ang gzhan don bsam pa tsam yod mod/ byams snying rje mthar ma phyin pas gzhan don du gtso bor dmigs pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /de nas gnyis pa phan yon bsam pa la bslab pa ni/ rang gi don thams cad sgrub pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo las byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad bskyed pa'i phyir sa bon lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan don bsgrub pa'i phan yon ni/ 'gro ba rnams kyi chos dkar po 'phel bas zhing sa lta bu'o/ /zhes so/ /nyes pa thams cad sel ba'i phan yon ni/ nyes par spyod pa thams cad zad pas sa'i 'og lta bu'o/ /zhes so/ /yon tan thob pa'i phan yon ni/ yon tan thams cad 'du bas rgya mtsho chen po lta bu'o/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar phan yon bzhi ste/ da lta byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa nyid nas rang rgyud kyi thar pa'i sa bon gsos thebs shing dge bas bag chags thams cad sad/ bsam pa bzang po des dngos su sems can la phan pa byed cing phan 'dogs pa'i nus pa yang rnyed 'ong*/ 'di bsgom tsam nyid nas sdig pa mang po 'dag cing chags sdang nga rgyal phrag dog sogs nyon mongs kyi dbal 'joms/ rgyud 'jam por song bas yon tan thams cad skye zhing*/ sangs rgyas bsgrub par dam bcas phyin/ yon tan gzhan mang po bsgrub dgos pa cig kyang shugs la 'ong*/

de nas mthar thug gi bar du rang don rtogs pa dang*/ gzhan don 'phrin las dang*/ spang bya spong ba dang*/ yon tan sgrub pa thams cad 'dir byed pa yin/ mdor na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yon tan ci tsam yod pa byang chub kyi sems la'ang yod pa yin/ sangs rgyas la ci tsam ri ba 'di la'ang ri snyam du byang chub kyi sems la spro sing nge ba bskyed la slar yang byang chub kyi sems sngar bzhin bsgom/ de ka yang yang bskyar/ thun mtshams su sems bskyed rang gis len pa'i cho gas kyang yang yang len pa'i dmigs pa sbyong*/ yang sngar sems bskyed ma thob na rgyun bshags kyi 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces 'byung ba de kha sems bskyed yin pas yan lag bdun pa yang yang bya/ dmigs skor zhe gcig pa'o// //gsum pa bslab bya la dam 'cha' ba ni/ bslab bya dang po sems can blos mi spang pa la bslab dgos te/ sems can blos spong ba la gnyis yod/ khyu ril du blos spong ba dang sgo thad du blos spong ba'o/ /dang po ni chos la 'jug pa'i blo log pa ste ngas rang don gzhan don gang yang mi yong 'jig rten phal pa bya snyam pa dang*/ theg chen la blo log pa ste sems can gyi don sgrub mi nus pas bdag nyan rang gi theg par sems bskyed dgos snyam pa lta bu yin/ sgo thad du blos spangs pa ni/ rang dang 'gal ba kha cig la khyod la phan thogs pa'i dus byung kyang gnas skabs mthar thug gang la ltos kyang*/ phan mi 'dogs snyam du snying brtse lhan gyis bral ba de yin/ de ltar khyu ril gyi blos spangs sam/ sgo thad kyi blos spangs kyang rung ste/ gnyen pos ma sleb par thun tshod gcig 'das na sems bskyed gtong ba yin par 'dug /bdag gis sems can spong ba'i blo nam du yang ma skyes pa zhig bya/ gal te dbang med du skyes kyang 'phral du gnyen pos sleb nas de ma thag bshags pa bya/ da lta dngos su phan gdags ma nus pa la yang phugs su phan par bya snyam du bsgom/

dmigs skor zhe gnyis pa'o// //bslab bya gnyis pa tshogs bsags pa la 'bad dgos/ bdag rim pas yon tan gong nas gong du song na tshogs gnyis rgya je che je che la bslab dgos/ nyi ma de ring rang nas tshogs gnyis la bslab dgos te bsod namasakyi tshogs ni/ mdo bstan bcos rnams las phan yon che bar bshad pa'i dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur/ 'byung po'i gtor ma/ phyag mchod bskor ba gzungs sngags bzlas pa dad pa bsgom pa byams snying rje bsgom pa/ bzod pa bsgom pa la sogs pa la bslab dgos snyam pa dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs chos nyan pa tshig 'dzin pa don sems pa 'gal 'brel gyi sgo nas rigs pas the tshom gcod pa/ 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog par rgyas 'debs pa zhes bya ba/ 'khor 'das thams cad bden med du thos pa'i sgo nas go zhing shes/ bsam pa'i sgo nas nges pa rnyed/ sgom pa'i sgo nas mngon sum du rtogs pa cig dgos pas don 'di la bslab dgos snyam pa dang*/ mchod pa la sogs pa bden med kyi lta bas zin pa dang*/ lta ba de'i ngang nas de ltar bslabs pas bsod nams kyi ye shes/ ye shes kyi bsod nams su song nas tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa cig bya'o snyam du yang yang bsam/ thun mtshams kun tu de dag las ji ltar 'os 'os lag len du thebs par yang bya/ dmigs skor zhe gsum pa'o// //bslab bya gsum pa zung bzhi ya brgyad la bslab dgos na/ nag po'i chos bzhi spyir yang nyes pa che/ sgos su skye ba 'phos na sems bskyed brjed pa'i rgyu yin/ dkar po'i chos bzhi spyir yang phan yon che/ sgos su skye ba thams cad du sems bskyed dran pa'i rgyu yin/ des na nag po'i chos bzhi spang*/ dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab dgos/de la zung dang po bla ma dang sbyin gnas dang mchod 'os bslu ba nag po'i chos yin/ bslu ba zhes bya ba de dag la rdzun gyi mgo skor gtong ba la zer/

de'i gnyen por shes bzhin gyis rdzun smra ba mtha' dag spangs pa yin/ skye bo tha mal pa la shes bzhin gyi rdzun phra mo yang mi smra na/ mchod 'os bslu ba lta ga la zhig /zung gnyis pa gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa nag po'i chos zer/ 'gyod pa'i gnas sdig pa byas pa la 'gyod pa bskyed dgos kyang*/ gnas ma yin pa dge ba byas pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa'i thabs byas na/ de 'gyod rung ma 'gyod rung nag po'i chos yin/ 'gyod pa bskyed tshul ni/ sbyin pa 'di ches te 'di tsam sbyin na ci za/ /zhes pa dang*/ khyod sdaum pa blangs na bu smad 'di kun kha zhan por 'gro zhes pa'am/ dgra la lan po ma byas pa des khyed stangs chag par 'gyur zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de'i gnyen por sems can rnams theg pa gsum gyi dge ba la smin par bya ba dkar po'i chos la bslab ste/ sems can rnams theg pa gsum po gang mos mos la sems bskyed du gzhug /sgos su theg chen la ci nus nus su dgod/ dge ba'i rigs ci 'grub byed du bcug /de yang byang chub tu smon lam 'debs su 'jug dgos te/ dge ba mi byed pa tsho yang slar nas dge ba la dgod gang thub byed dgos na 'gyod pa bskyed pa ga la 'ong*/ da ni zung gsum pa la slob ste/ sems bskyed pa'i gang zag la tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod pa nag po'i chos zer/ tshigs bcad ma yin pa ni dngos sam lkog tu skyon brjod pa yin/ sems bskyed skyes rung ma skyes rung nyams rung ma nyams rung 'dra/ sems bskyed blangs so zer ba tshun chod smad du mi rung*/ de'i gnyen por sems can thams cad la ston pa'i 'du shes bsgom pa la bslab pa dkar po'i chos yin/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin pa dang tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi yul la sangs rgyas dang 'dra/ ji skad du/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba la/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba la/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar yin/ des na ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas rtag tu bsngags pa dang bstod ra brjod par bya/ sems can phal pa la yang mi smod cing bsngags pa brjod na/ sems bskyed pa la mi smod pa lta ci smos/ zung bzhi pa sems can la g.yo sgyus kun tu spyod pa nag po'i chos zer/ rang gi don bsgrub pa'i phyir du gzhan la khram dang gya bskor byed pa/ tha na bre srang tshun chad la g.yo sgyu byas kyang rung ste nag po'i chos yin/ de'i gnyen por sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba dang lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa dkar po'i chos yin/ phan pa dang bde ba ni tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi bde ba la 'god pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa ni gzhan don gyi khur rang gis khyer ba la yang zer/ yang g.yo thabs kyi gya gyu mi byed par bsam pa drang pos tshig gsong por smra ba pha ma bu tsha ltar phyi nang med pa la'ang zer bas de lta bu la bslab dgos/ sems can thams cad la phan bde lhag bsam du gnas dgos na/ phar la g.yo sgyu 'tshong ba'i go skabs ga la yod/ dkar po'i chos 'di rnams la shin tu nan tan snying por bya rgyu yin par 'dug bdag deng nas bzung ste nag po'i chos bzhi nam du yang mi byed/ dkar po'i chos bzhi la ci nus ci lcogs kyis bslab par bya'o snyam du bsam/ dmigs skor zhe bzhi pa'o// //'dir zung bzhi re re la dmigs skor re re mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod/ blo 'khobs chung ba la de ltar byas na nges shes skye zhing legs par 'ong yang 'ong ngo*/ /yang sems bskyed kyi phan yon dran pa dang*/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu sems bskyed len pa yang bslab byar bsdus te/ sems can mi spang pa/ tshogs gnyis la bslab pa/ zung bzhi la re re ste bslab bya brgyad zer ba'ang yod pas ji ltar 'os par sbyar bar bya'o/ /snying rje'i khrid song ba'i mtshams su sems bskyed blangs nas/ de rjes smon sems kyi khrid 'di rnams bskyangs na go rim 'grig mdog kha zhing legs par 'gyur la/

yang thog mar dmigs pa 'di rnams byang bar byas te/ bar 'dir sems bskyed blangs na cho gas len pa'i skabs der nges shes skye tshabs che bas skabs 'dir byas na yang legs par 'gyur/ yang khrid yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthar byang sdom len pa'i sngon du sems bskyed blangs kyang rung ste ji ltar skabs su bab pa de ltar bya'o// //gnyis pa 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems la bslab pa ni 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas 'thob par 'dod pas byang chub spyod pa la bslab dgos/ sangs rgyas 'grub par 'dod kyang spyod pa la mi slob na/ lo legs par 'dod skad so nam mi byed pa dang 'dra/ spyir byang chub tu smon pa tsam la'ang phan yon mang mod kyi/ byang chub spyod pa nyams su ma blangs na yon tan gong 'phel du mi 'gro bas spyod pa la bslab dgos/ spyod pa'i ngo bo yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi yin/ phar phyin dang bsdu dngos bya ba yang logs logs su med/ phyin drug rang gis nyams su len/ /gzhan la tshig gi sgo nas ston/ /gzhan rnams byed du 'jug pa de kha phar phyin kyang yin bsdud dngos kyang yin/ bdag gis pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la nan tan snying por bsgrub par bya'o/ /de yang phyi dus phyi dus na ma yin par da lta nyid du 'jug par bya'o snyam pa yang yang sbyong ba yin/ 'di skabs dam bca' dang lag len ma 'dzol bar ci nus ci lcogs kyis lag len du thebs pa nyi ma de ring nas byed dgos pa yin no/ /zhes bya ste 'jug sems spyir bsgom pa yin na/ dmigs skor zhe lnga pa'o// //bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod dgos na/ dang por sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab dgos/ sbyin pa de la dbye na gsum/ zang zing gi sbyin pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa/ chos kyi sbyin pa gsum mo/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad la zang zing gi sbyin pa byin la tshims par bya/ da lta de tsam gyi nus pa med de phyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid tshun chod bzung la sbyin dgos snyam pa bsam pa'i sgo nas bslab/

da lta rang yang rang gi nus pa dang sbyar la chos kyi 'gal rkyen du mi 'gro tsam gyi sgo nas/ zas gos la sogs pa ci nus ci lcogs su sbyin/ ma tha rang la yang slong mo ba kha stong du mi gtong tsam re mi byed pa'i thabs mi 'dug bsam zhing*/ 'di dmigs pa tsam ma yin pa lag len du yang khel nges pa dgos te/ sbyor ba la bslab pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa/ bdag gis sems can thams cad nad kyi 'jigs pa dang*/mtshon gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ dug gi 'jigs pa dang*/ gcan gzan dang dug sbrul la sogs pa srog chags gdug pa can gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ g.yang sa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ lam 'phrang g-i 'jigs pa dang*/ me'i 'jigs pa dang*/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ chad pas gcod pa'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa'i bar thams cad las bskyab par bya snyam du bsam pas sbyangs da lta yang dngos su nad dang gdon dang dgra dang 'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa sogs las ci nus ci lcogs kyis skyob pa'i thabs bya'o snyam du bsgom zhing*/ dmigs par ma zad lag len gyi sgo nas kyang tshul khrims dang sgrub pa'i bar chad du mi 'gyur ba rnams ci 'grub tu bya zhing*/ tha na kha phan tshig phan tshun chod bya ba sbyor ba'i sgo nas bslab pa yin/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa byas kyang sems can sdug bsngal ba la phan 'dogs pa'i ming yin/ skabs su ma bab pa dang sdig rkyen du 'gro na khye yis gyong mi subs pa 'byung nyen che bas/ bsam pas sbyong dgos kyang sbyor ba btang snyoms su 'jog pa'i skabs yin no/ /chos kyi sbyin pa bdag gis sems can thams cad chos kyi sbyin pas tshims par bya/ bdag gis chos bstan te sems can ma smin pa rnams smin par bya/ smin pa rnams grol bar bya/ ma go ba rnams gor gzhug ma rtogs pa rnams rtogs su gzhug ma thob pa rnams thob tu gzhug snyam du bsam pa'i sgo nas sbyangs/

da lta yang rang la chos bshad pa'i nus pa yod na rnyed bkur dang khengs grags la mi lta bar gzhan la chos bshad pas phan 'dogs dgos/ de ltar mi nus pa zhig yin na'ang mi dang mi ma yin la chos bshad par mos te/ mdo 'don pa'am gsung rab sgrog pa'i thun ma chags par bya'o snyam du bsam pas sbyang bar bya zhing*/ de dmigs par ma zad lag len du yang khel bar byed pa ni sbyor ba'i sgo nas bslab pa yin te/ de ltar na sbyin pa gsum la bsam sbyor gnyis gnyis kyi bslab tshul te drug yod/ yongs bsdoms nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab pa yin te/ dmigs skor zhe drug pa'o// //bsam sbyor so so la bslab tshul 'di phyi ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre/ da gzhan yang tshul khrims kyi phar phyin la bslab dgos/ tshul khrims la gsum/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum mo/ /nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ spyir mi dge pa bcu sogs rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba thams cad spangs pa zhig dang*/ sgos su dge bsnyen nam dge slong ngam/ dge tshul lam byang sdom gyi bslab bya'am/ sngags kyi dam tshig sogs rang gis gang blangs pa'i sdom khrims kyi bsrung bya dang ma 'gal ba zhig dgos/ mdor na mdo dang bstan bcos las mi rung bar gsungs pa thams cad las zlog pa ste/ bdag gis 'di la 'phral du bslab par bya snyam du bsgom/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims ni/ dge ba sna re dang phyogs rer ma song bar phar phyin drug gis bsdus pa thams cad la rtag tu bslab dgos pa'i don yin/ de la'ang da lta rang nas ci nus ci lcogs su bsgrub/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims ni/ sems can rnams bde ba dang dge ba sna tshogs pa la 'god pa'i sgo nas phan bsgrub pa la zer/ de yang bdag gis ci nus ci lcogs kyis da lta rang nas kyang sems can rnams phan pa dang bde ba la 'god gang thub bya snyam du bsgom/

nyes spyod sdom pa la phyi dus 'debs su med thos ma thag nas bcag ste zlog dgos/ phyi ma gnyis la phyi dus cig kyang 'debs su yod de/ rang gi blo stobs dang bstun nas da lta gang nus gang lcogs byas/ da lta mi thub pa rnams phyis smon lam gyi yul du bzhag pas chog pa yin/ spyir byang chub sems dpa' gzhan don ma byas na de nyid nyes pa che shos yin te/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims dgos/ gzhan don byed pa la rang rgyud smin dgos pas dge ba chos sdud dgos pa yin/ rang nyes ltung gis ma gos pa gcig pus kyang mi chog pa cig yin par 'dug na'ang*/ thog ma'i gzhi la nyes spyod sdom pa rang gal che ste/ 'di med na gzhan gnyis kyang ji bzhin mi yong ba lags/ dmigs skor zhe bdun pa'o// //da ni bzod pa'i phar phyin la gsum/ gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa ste gsum mo/ /de'i dang po ni/ gzhan gyi bdag la brdeg pa dang*/ kha zer ba dang*/ nor 'phrog pa la sogs pa'i gnod pa byas pa'i tshe mi bzod cing zhe sdang skye ba'i rnam 'gyur yong bas/ bdag sangs rgyas bsgrub rgyu yin pa la gnod pa 'di tsam ma bzod pas ga na 'ong*/ khams gsum sems can dgrar gyur nas gnod pa sgo mi 'dra ba thams cad nas byed kyang bzod sran tshugs par bya/ gnod pa 'di tsam yang mi bzod par sangs rgyas thob tu re ba dang chos pa yin du re ba nga rang 'khrul snyam du bsgom/ sdug bsngal dang len gyi bzod pa ni chos sgrub pa'i dus na tsha grang ltogs skom la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal byung ba'am/ lam bgrod dka' ba dang*/ mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa dang*/ ngal dub thang chad nyi lhags char gsum sogs gang byung kyang*/ bdag chos ky-i phyir du dka' spyad phra mo 'di tsam ma bzod pas ga la yong*/ nor dang bu smad kyi phyir/ 'di 'dra bas brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyi sdug bsngal che ba kun la'ang tsham tshom med par 'jug gin gda' ba/

bdag sangs rgyas bsgrub dgos pa la sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar la slob dgos na/ chos phyir dka' ba 'di tsam yang mi bzod par theg chen par khas 'che ba re blun no snyam du gnyen po brtan thang gis btang*/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa ni thabs zab mo dang*/ thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang*/ mdzad pa rlabs po che dang*/ yon tan mtha' yas pa dang*/ gnas lugs spros bral sogs gang la'ang blor mi shong ba med pa cig la zer/ stong nyid la sems yun ring du gnas thub pa cig la'ang zer/ da res 'dir gnod pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad sgyu ma lta bu bden pas stong pa med bzhin du snang ba yin na/ mi bzod rgyu ci yod snyam du bsgom par bya'o/ / dmigs skor zhe brgyad pa'o// //da ni gzhan yang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la bslab dgos te/ de la gsum go cha'i brtson 'grus/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ slar mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus so/ /go cha'i brtson 'grus ni/ chos dge ba thams cad la 'di lta bu byed mi dgos snyams pa'i khyad gsod dang*/ chen po rnams la 'di tsam sgrub mi nus snyam pa'i zhum pa'i sems gnyis kar mi byed par/ bdag gis 'di dag thams cad bsgrub kyang dgos/ bsgrub nus pa yang yin da lta nyid du bsgrub par bya'o/ /rgyun mi 'chad par bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes sems kyi dam bca' dang 'brel ba'i dge ba la spro sems dpa' ma zhum pa de yin/ de rang gi rgyud thog tu sbyar nas yang yang bsgom par bya/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus ni dngos su lag len la sbyor ba'i skabs/ le lo dang rnam g.yeng gi dbang du mi gtong bar spro ba dang bcas pas 'phral du dge ba la 'jug cing*/ de nyid spro bzhin du rgyun bsring ba'o/ /slar mi zlog pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ drod rtags dang phan yon 'phral du ma byung na'ang*/ dang por gang la zhugs pa de'i 'bras bu mngon du ma gyur par yun c-i tsam 'gor yang rung*/

dka' ba ci tsam spyod dgos kyang rung spro ba ye mi zlog pa'o/ /yang bstan rim gyi man ngag 'ga' zhig las/ lus kyi brtson 'grus phyag dang bskor ba sogs/ ngag gi brtson 'grus bzlas brjod kha bton sogs/ yid kyi brtson 'grus spyir dge ba dang sgos su chos 'di la sprau zhing brtson pa ste/ zhes pa'ang yod pas/ gang ltar yang rung brtson 'grus ni de rnams yin na bdag kyang brtson 'grus dang ldan par bya/ le lo phyi bshol gyi dbang du ma btang bar dge ba la spro bar bya'o snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor zhe dgu pa'o// //da ni gzhan yang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bya ba yod de/ de'i rgyu tshogs la da lta nas gnas dgos/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyur sems dben pa gcig dgos/ de'i rgyur lus dben pa dgos/ de'i rgyur don nyung la bya ba nyung ba dgos/ de'i rgyur 'dod pa chung zhing chog shes pa dgos/ de'i rgyur zas gos gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa dgos/ bdag kyang ci ste 'byor pa dang ldan na de la ma chags par ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ gal te ma 'byor na yang ma 'byor ba nyid bzang ste chos kyi bar chad med pa yin/ gang byung de kas chog snyam pa yang yang bsam zhing bsgom/ des ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu bsam pa song*/ dmigs skor lnga bcu pa'o// //dngos ni bsam gtan la dbye na/ dbye sgo mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang*/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba/ lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba bsgrub pa yin/ yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba/ spyi ldog nas mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa sgrub par byed pa rnams yin/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs la brten nas gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob par byed pa'am/ mngon shes kyi khyad par la brten nas sems can gyi don spyod pa yin/ de thams cad kyang zhi gnas skyon dang bral zhing mtshan nyid rdzogs pa cig la brten dgos/

bdag gis thog mar zhi gnas la sems mnyam par bzhag par bya/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par gzhan thams cad kyang bsgrub par bya'o snyam du yang yang bsgom/ dmigs skor nga gcig pa'o// //skabs 'dir zhi gnas kyi rnam gzhag zhib tsam bshad cing nges par byung na legs/ zhi gnas kyi 'khrid kyang 'dir ston pa thob thang yin mod kyang lta ba la nges pa dang nyams myong rnyed par 'gyur ba tsam la/ zhi gnas brtan po med kyang chog pa dang*/ zhi gnas brtan po legs po bsgrub nas/ de'i 'og tu lta ba bskyangs te lhag mthong sgrub pa gzhung chen kun gyi dgongs pa dang*/ gzhung lam chen mo yin mod kyang deng sang gi gang zag dbang po rtul pos/ sems gnas skyon med brtan po zhig sgrub pa la yun ring du 'thog pas sher phyin sgom pa'i skal ba chad kyis dogs pa dang*/ lta ba'i myong ba rnyed pa'i steng du sems gnas bsgrub na zhi lhag lhan cig tu 'grub ste/ slob ma 'khrid bla myong ba rnyed bla ba'i gnad yod par dgongs nas phyag len la skabs 'dir mi mdzad pa yin par snang ngo*/ /da ni de thams cad kyi nang nas ches mchog tu gyur pa bslab bya kun gyi gtso bo yang yin/ nyams len kun gyi mthar thug kyang yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ston par byed/ de la shes rab ni gsum yod de/ don dam shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ kun rdzob shes pa'i shes rab dang*/ gzhan don shes pa'i shes rab ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni gnas lugs stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab yin/ gnyis pa ni shes bya thams cad kyi ngo bo dbye ba rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma nor bar shes pa'i shes rab yin/ gsum pa ni bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro don shes pa'i shes rab ste/ de la zang zing gi sbyin pa btang ste skye bo rnams mgu nas chos la 'god thub pa shes/ bsam pa dang mthun par chos ston pa'i snyan par smra ba shes/ don spyod pa gzhan phyin drug la 'god thabs shes/

don mthun pa rang yang phyin drug las mi 'da' bar spyod shes pa ste/ de'i nang gi gzhan phyin drug la 'god pa ni/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi thabs shes pa'i sgo nas yin no/ /yang na thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i shes rab ste/ thos pas go bsam pas sgro 'dogs chod bsgom pas mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab ste/ gsum po 'di rnams bdag gis ci nas kyang rgyud la bskyed par bya'o/ /'di sher phyin gyi bsam pa la bslab pa yin/ dmigs skor nga gnyis pa'o// //da ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sbyor ba la bslab dgos te/ de la gang zag gi bdag med bsgom pa/ chos kyi bdag med bsgom pa/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la bslab pa ste gsum mo/ / dang po ni/ sngon 'gro dang rjes sogs sngar bshad pa ltar las/ dngos gzhi'i skabs 'dir rkang pa skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag rgal tshigs bsrang*/ mgrin pa dgug dpung ba phyir bskyed/ so mchu rang sar bzhag cing lce rtse rkan la sbyar/ mig sna rtser lta/ de nas rlung sna nas lan gsum phyi la sang sang ba 'bud/ de rjes dbugs rang sor bzhag /nges 'byung skyo shas dung tsam dang byams snying rje rgyud 'gyur tsam bsgom/ de nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la sems gtad/ gzhig 'grel bcug /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas nga bdag tu 'dzin pa goms pas bdag yod yod ltar snang ba ma gtogs/ nga bdag ces pa gnas tshul la grub pa ye med par 'dug snyam du bsam/ 'di dmigs pa'i gzhi yin de la nga'am bdag ces bya ba/ gnas lugs la yod na da de gang zag gi bdag yin mod/ de 'dra dngos po la ye ma grub pas gang zag gi bdag de 'dra ngo bo'i sgo nas ston rgyu med/ 'on kyang med pa la yod par 'dzin pa'i bdag 'dzin gyi 'dzin stangs rlom tshul dang bstun na rtag pa gcig pu rang dbang can du 'dzin pa yin/ de yang na ning ngas 'di byas/ nga da gzod 'di byed snyam pa/

na ning gi nga de da lta'i nga 'di yin/ 'di da gzod yang 'gro snyam pa de la rtag par 'dzin pa zer/ nga snyam pa shar dus phyi nang gi dngos po gzhan su dang yang ma 'dres pa'i kho rang gi ngo bo tshugs thub cig yod pa'i khungs su snang ba de gcig pur 'dzin pa yin/ ji ltar rigs pa'i longs spyod dam/ rdzas sam 'khor la rang nyid bdag po'i tshul du yod pa ltar snang ba de rang dbang can du 'dzin pa zhes bya ba yin/ 'dzin stangs kyis de ltar bzung yang de lta bur ma grub ste/ gal te bdag de rtag na ni bdag de lan cig bde ba myong ba rtag tu bde dgos pa dang*/ lan cig sdug bsngal myong na rtag tu sdug dgos pa dang*/ dus dang po 'khor bar bcings na phyis grol ba'i dus mi srid pa dang*/ phyis grol ba'i gnas skabs su yod na/ sngon 'khor ba ma myong bar thal ba las bde sdug spel ma dang*/ bcings grol gyi gnas skabs so sor 'byung bas rtag pa'i bdag med par thag chod/ gcig pu yang mi 'thad de bdag ces bya ba/ rang g-i lus sems kyi phung po la yod pa ltar snang na/ mig kyang bdag ma yin/ rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid kyang bdag ma yin/ de dag re re bzhin bdag yin na du mar 'gyur/ re re nas bdag ma yin na bdag ma rnyed/ gzhan yang bdag phung po yin na bdag mi rtag par thal/ bdag phung po las gzhan yin na mig shes kyis mthong ba la bdag gis mthong*/ lus kyis reg pa la bdag gis reg ces pa'i 'du shes 'byung ba 'gal/ de'i phyir gcig pu'i rang bzhin can gyi nga bdag ma grub/ gcig pu ma grub pas rang dbang can mi 'grub/ khyad par du yang bya byed thams cad rkyen la rag lus par mngon sum du mthong bas/ rang dbang can gyi bdag mi srid/ gzhan yang phung po'i phyi rol na yang bdag ma grub/ phung po'i nang na'ang bdag mi gnas/ phung po re re'ang bdag min/ phung po bsal ba'i shul na'ang bdag med/ phung po'i spyi la'ang bdag med de re re las gzhan pa'i spyi ma grub pa'i phyir ro/

/des na bdag ces bya ba ni blos btags pa tsam/ 'khrul ngo tsam/ phyin ci log kho na yin gyi/ ngo bos grub pa ni 'ga' yang med do snyam du bsgom/ dmigs skor nga gsum pa'o// //gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa 'di la blo'i 'khobs dang bstun pa'i dmigs skor dum bu 'ga' shas su bcad kyang rung ba lags/ da ni chos kyi bdag med ston te chos zhes pa phung khams skye mched la zer/ de rnams la blos btags pa tsam ma yin par rang tshugs thub pa'i dngos po cig yod srid na de chos kyi bdag yin mod kyang*/ de 'dra ye mi srid pas chos thams cad chos kyi bdag med pa yin no/ /de ltar yin yang 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas phung khams skye mched rnams/ rang tshugs su grub par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'di sbyang ba'i phyir chos kyi bdag med bsgom dgos pa yin no/ /de la dang por rang rgyud kyi phung po rang bzhin med par bsgom dgos/ de'i yang thog ma rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs phung lus kyi chos la bltas na/ dngos po sna tshogs tshogs pa ltar snang ba gcig la lus zhes spyi ming cig tu btags nas/ ming dang mtshungs pa'i dngos po zhig yod do snyam/ blau phyin ci log gis bzung ba ma gtogs de ltar ma grub ste/ dang por lus 'di la mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus kyi dbang po rnams kyang tha dad/ dbang po rnams dang mi gcig pa'i dbang rten khog pa yang so so re 'dug /mgo bo dang mgrin pa dang brang dang rgyab dang sked pa dang pho ba dang lto ba dang phrag pa gnyis dang dpung pa gnyis dang bar lhu gnyis dang lag ngar gnyis dang lag mgo gnyis dang dpyi gnyis dang byin pa gnyis dang rkang mgo gnyis dang*/ don lnga snod drug sogs nang khrol rnams dang bu ga dgu la sogs pa sna tshogs pa 'dus pa'i phung po yin snyam du bsam/ des na lus zhes bya ba blos btags pa ma gtogs bden par mi 'dug /de rnams re re nas lus yin na lus mang po can du 'gyur/

re re nas min na ni lus ma rnyed/ tshogs pa tsam yin no snyam na/ re re las gzhan pa'i tshogs pa med pa'i phyir blos btags pa tsam ma gtogs med par song ngo*/ /dmigs skor nga bzhi pa'o// //yang gzugs kyi phung pos bsdus pa'i lus 'di bden par ma grub ste/ rkang lag bzhi stod smad mgo brang zhol nang khrol te gzugs dgur 'gro/ gzugs re re nas grub bam snyam na ma grub ste/ re re bzhin lhu gsum gsum la sogs par 'gro/ lhu re re nas bden nam snyam na mi bden te sor tshigs tsam du mar 'gro/ sor tshad re re nas grub bam snyam na ma grub ste re re nas nas tsam bdun bdun du 'gro/ de re re nas kyang mi bden te shig gi tshad tsam bdun bdun mthar sro ma dang*/ nyi zer rdul dang*/ glang rdul dang/ lug rdul dang*/ ri bong rdul dang*/ chu rdul dang*/ lcags rdul gyi bar du snga ma snga ma'i dkyus kyi tshad bdun bdun du btubs pas phyi ma phyi ma'i tshad du 'gyur/ lcags rdul re re nas bden nam snyam na mi bden te/ lcags rdul gyi dkyus kyi tshad la rdul phran bdun yod/ der yang ma grub ste rdul phran re re la rdul phra rab bdun yod do/ /bdun 'gyur 'di rnams la dkyus zheng rgya dpangs thams cad bsdoms na/ snga ma snga ma gsil bas phyi ma phyi ma sum brgya bzhi bcu zhe gsum re yod/ dkyus la bdun yod pa zheng la'ang de tsam yin pas bzhi bcu zhe dgur 'gyur la de tsam la dpangs su yang bdun yod pas so/ /dmigs skor nga lnga ba'o// //rdul phra rab re re bzhin bden par grub bam snyam na ma grub ste/ re re bzhin phyogs re dang*/ steng 'og tu lta ba'i cha re ste drug tu snang la/ dbus kyi cha gcig kyang yod dgos te de med na shar nub sogs la lta ba rtsom mi thub pas so/ /de ltar cha bdun po re re la yang de bzhin du phye bas de yang ma grub/ de ltar thug med du phye bas mtha' med de/

lus zhes bya ba blos btags pa tsam ma gtogs gnas tshul la ma grub pa kho na'o/ /des na snang ba tsam ma 'gags pa sgyu ma lta bu la/ rang bzhin gdod nas gang du'ang ma grub ste/ dngos po 'di rnams de ltar na gcig tu ma grub/ de ma grub pas du mar yang mi 'grub ste/ gcig gcig por grub pa mang por bsags pa las du ma grub dgos pa'i phyir ro// dmigs skor nga drug pa'o// //'o na gzugs phung mi bden yang sems su bden pa yin snyam na/ sems la dbye na'ang gzugs mthong ba dang sgra tshor ba la sogs pa gtso bo rnam par shes pa/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad so sor 'dug ste/ rnam shes kyi phung po yang du mar zhig ste thal/ bde sdug btang snyoms myong ba sogs tshor bar 'dug ste/ tshor ba yang gcig tu ma grub/ mtho dman bzang ngan ming don sna tshogs 'dzin pa sogs 'du shes su 'dug ste/ de la'ang gcig tu ngos bzung ma byung lhag ma 'dod chags zhe sdang dad pa la sogs pa rnam rtog mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig la blos bsdoms nas 'du byed ces btags par zad kyi sems zhes bya ba yang gcig tu ma grub gcig ma grub pas du mar yang ma grub bo zhes bsgom ste/ dmigs skor nga bdun pa'o// //da shes pa'i rnam grangs de thams cad kyang rig rig tur tur por 'di'i rnam 'gyur ma gtogs tshugs thub tu mi 'dug /dper na chu la ri brag gi gzugs brnyan shar ba dang 'dra/ rig rig po 'di la bltas na 'das pa'i sems ni 'gags nas med/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems ni ma skyes nas med/ da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma byas kyang rang ngos nas bden par grub pa med de skad cig gcig po de la'ang snga ma dang 'brel ba skye ba'i cha gcig dang*/ phyi ma dang 'brel ba 'gags pa'i cha gcig dang*/ dbus na gnas pa'i cha gcig ste sil bur 'gro/ de'i dbus kyi cha la ltos na cha gsum sogs thug med du dpyad na mtha' med du song nas/ gang yang gcig pu'i ngo bo ma grub pa der gda'/

gcig ma grub pas du ma mi 'grub pa sogs gong bzhin te/ dmigs skor nga brgyad pa'o// //des rang rgyud kyi phung po bden med du gtan la phab zin/ da n-i rang gi lus sems kyis bsdus pa'i phung po lnga po bden med du gtan la phebs zin pa de bzhin du/ sems can thams cad kyi lus sems phung po lnga yang de dang 'dra/ khyad par du dgra sdang ba'am gnyen byams pa lta bu nyon mongs drag tu skye ba'i yul cig la ched gtad du dmigs nas/ rang gi lus la dpyad pa bzhin de'i lus la yang dpyad/ rang gi sems ming gzhi'i phung po la dpyad pa bzhin du/ de'i sems la yang dpyad de des na skye bo che ge mo dang*/ ga ge mo zhes bya ba 'di kun yang blos btags nas sems can de dang de'o zhes phyin ci log tu btags par zad kyi/ nges par na gang du yang ma grub pas sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes sbyangs nas/ des thams cad la rigs 'gres te bsgom dgos so/ /'di bcud kyi sems cad thams cad stong par bsgom pa zhes bya ste/ dmigs skor nga dgu pa'o// //yang bcud kyi sems can du ma zad phyi snod kyi 'jig rten yang mi bden te/ stong gsum bshig pas stong bar ma dang*/ de bzhin du stong spyi phud dang*/ gling bzhi pa dang*/ 'dzam bu gling lta bu dang*/ rgyal khams gcig dang*/ dpag tshad tsam dang*/ rgyang grags tsam dang*/ 'dom gang tsam dang*/ khru gru bzhi pa dang*/ sor gcig tsam dang nas tsam nas rdul phra rab kyi bar du bshig na snga ma snga ma ma grub cing*/ rdul phran yang sngon bzhin du bshig pas mthar gang yang ma grub/ gcig tu ma grub pas du ma mi 'grub pa sogs gong bzhin te/ mdor na 'di dang 'di lta bu'o/ /'di ni khang khyim mo/ /'di ni zhing ngo*/ /'di ni 'bru'o/ /'di ni nor rdzas so/ /'di ni lo thog go /de bzhin du ri dang thang dang chu dang rgyal khams la sogs par 'dzin pa dag kyang*/ bden dngos su ma grub pa'i tshogs par snang ba tsam la blos ming 'dog tha dad btags nas bden dngos su 'dzin pa tsam du zad kyi/

don du na cung zad tsam yang grub pa med do snyam du 'dun pa sbyangs/ snod kyi 'jig rten stong par bsgom pa ste/ dmigs skor drug cu pa'o// //yang rang gzhan snod bcud mthong thos gzugs can thogs bcas thams cad ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' ste khams lngas bsdus/ rig tsam 'gyu ba thams cad ni rnam par shes pas bsdus/ de la 'byung ba bzhi po ni/ phra mor na rang tshugs ma thub ste 'dres shing gnas sa'i rdul phran yang ma grub ste 'byung ba gzhan dang 'dres pa'i phyir dang*/ phan tshun gcig la gcig brten te gnas pa ma gtogs/ rang tshugs thub par sdod pa'i skabs gang yang mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /nam mkha' zhes bya ba ni gzugs can de rnams med pa'i shul la blos btags pa ma gtogs bya byed med cing bden dngos med la/ rnam par shes pa yang rkyen glo bur ba'i snang cha tsam ma gtogs/ ngos bzung du med pas rang bzhin snod bcud thams cad gnas tshul la ye ma grub la/ re zhig 'khrul ba can gyi blo la snang cha ma 'gags kyang rang bzhin med pas sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du bsgom/ snod bcud thams cad stong par bsgom pa ste/ dmigs skor drug cu re gcig pa'o// //gzhan yang dngos med ces bya ba ni dngos po la brten nas blos bzhag pa tsam yin gyi don dam par lta ci smos/ kun rdzob blang dor gyi yul du yang ma grub ste gang yang yod pa ma yin la/ gong du snang grags kyi chos 'di dag thams cad ye nas ma grub bo zhes bsam mod/ gdod nas rtsa ba dang bral ba la stong pa'i chos zhes bya ba yang med de/ mo bsham gyi bu dang po nas byung ba ma srid pas mo bsham gyi bu med ces pa'ang mi srid de/ de 'dra ba'i stong pa yang mi stong pa la ltos te blos bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ yod med yin min sogs cir yang ma grub pa la blos gang du'ang mi 'dzin par gsal la rtog med kyi ngang du lhan ne 'jog /yang rtog pa skyes byung na de'i ngo bo la bltas te ngos bzung dang bral ba de ka bsgom/

dmigs pa snga ma dang 'di gnyis sbrel nas gsal la yun thung ba yang yang bsgom pa gnad du che/ mthar thug spros bral bsgom pa'i dmigs pa ste/ dmigs skor re gnyis pa'o// //de nas de thams cad bsdoms nas bsgom ste sngar gyi go ba rnams yud cig dran par byas nas/ rang gzhan snod bcud 'di dag thams cad la nga bdag ces bya ba yang ma grub/ byed pa po gang yang med de rten 'brel tshogs pa tsam las snang ba yin/ 'di thams cad gcig dang du ma gang yang ma grub pas 'khrul ngor snang tsam ma gtogs/ gnas lugs la ci yang ma grub cing legs par brtags na ma grub pa dang med pa zhes bya ba yang*/ blos yod pa'i mtshan nyid gcig gsar du bcos nas de dang 'gal bar snang ba la/ med pa dang ma grub pa'i tha snyad btags pa tsam du zad do/ /de ltar phan tshun brtags pas dmigs gtad yal ba de la ci yang mi bsam par mnyam par bzhag cing*/ sngar gyi dmigs gtad sangs pa'i ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba'i rnam cha de ma yal bar du mi rtog pa de la bzhag /yang de yal song na stong nyid kyi rnam pa nub pa'i mi rtog pa tsam la mi 'jug ste/ sngar gyi de bskyar gyin bsgom dgos pas yal ma yal gyi sa mtshams shes pa gal che gsung*/ thog ma'i skabs su stong pa'i rnam pa yun ring mi sdod pa 'dra ba zhig yong yang nyams myong gi sne zhig rnyed pa'i mtshams nas je ring je ring la 'gro/ 'di ka dmigs pa la sems gtad pa'i 'jog pa dang*/ de'i rgyun bsring ba nye bar 'jog pa yin/ rnam rtog byung tshad 'phro gcod pa de bslan te 'jog pa yin/ de nas yun je ring je ring la 'gro ba de nye bar 'jog pa yin/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dran nas dga' ba bsgoms pas lhag par bsgom pa la spro ba 'byung ste 'dul bar byed pa yin/ res 'ga' rnam g.yeng la sogs pa'i nyes dmigs dran pas rnam g.yeng sogs rang 'gags la 'gro ste zhi bar byed pa yin/

de gnyis spro ba bskyed pa dang skyo shas bskyed pa'i rnam grangs yin/ re dogs dang chags sdang g-i rnam rtog gang byung ba thams cad gang skyes kyi ngo bo la cer re bltas pas/ sngar shes pa bden med du bsgoms pa des rgyas thebs nas rang babs su zhi ba ni nye bar zhi ba yin/ re zhig bar la rgyud lang shor can de thabs de dag gis yang yang 'tsho dgos shing*/ de nas ci zhig ltar na sems bsgrims na bying rgod kyi skyon med cing*/ dmigs yul stong pa'i rnam pa de la sems yun ring du gnas pa 'byung*/ de skabs bsgrim dgos te sems kyi rgyud gcig tu byed bya ba de yin/ mthar sngar gyi lta ba'i nyams myong dran tsam byas nas bzhag pa kho nas stong pa'i rnam pa can de yun ring du gnas pa 'byung ste/ de'i tshe rtsol ba klod de rang babs su 'jog dgos pas mnyam par bzhag pa zhes bya ba grub pa yin no/ /sgom skyong tshul 'di chos mngon pa las/ lhag mthong sngon du song ba'i zhi gnas sgom tshul gcig kyang yod pa de'i lugs yin/ 'di ka ma la shī la'i sgom rim la sogs pa'i lugs dang mtshungs par dpyad pa sngon song gi mi rtog pa sgom tshul yin/ bshes gnyen po to ba chen po'i be'u bum las/ dpal ldan a ti sha'i lugs la dpyad pa sngon song kho na dgos par gsungs/ 'on kyang a ti sha'i blau sbyong gi gdams ngag 'ga' re sogs mdo lugs dang*/ phyag chen sogs sngags kyi gdams ngag mang po la/ dpyad pa spangs pa'i gdams ngag kyang shin tu mang mod/ re zhig bstan rim gyi man ngag ston pa'i skabs 'dir/ bshes gnyen chen po po to bas gsungs pa ltar byed dgos so/ /dmigs skor re gsum mo// //lta ba skyong lugs 'di'i rigs la sems gnas pa nam grub pa na lhag mthong yang grub ste/ thog ma nyid nas zhi lhag zung du 'jug pa nyid yod par bzhed do// gsum pa stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can ni/

de la stong rkyang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub par mi 'gro bas/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug cig dgos pa yin/ de ltar na don dam par snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos gang yang ma grub par 'dug /dpe nam mkha' dang 'dra/ de ltar na grub pa la ma grub par mngon gsum du rtogs na/ sdug bsngal myong ba po'i sems can yang med/ myong rgyu'i sdug bsngal yang med/ myong tshul las nyon sdug bsngal gsum phan tshun gcig nas gcig tu 'khor 'gro rgyu yang gdod nas ma grub par 'dug mod/ de ltar ma rtogs tsa na sdug bsngal myong ba po'i sems can gyi snang ba yang shar/ myong bya sdug bsngal gyi snang ba yang shar/ myong tshul dang 'khor tshul yang shar/ de thams cad med bzhin du snang ba yin kyang sgyu mas bslus pa'i sems can ltar sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ba snying re rje/ 'di rnams 'khrul ba sangs te gnas lugs rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas la 'god par bya/ don dam par bdag kyang ma grub sems can de rnams kyang ma grub/ 'khrul ba yang ma grub 'khrul ba sel bar byed pa'i lam yang ma grub mod kyi/ kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam du sdug bsngal dang sgrib pa yod par snang ba bzhin du/ lam yang yod par snang*/ lam bsgoms pas 'khrul ba sangs te gnas lugs la ngang gis gnas pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'ang yin pa la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i bdag gis sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can rnams la/ sgyu ma lta bu'i lam mam chos bstan pas sgyu ma lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis sha thang chad pa 'di dbyings su grol bar bya'o/ /sdug bsngal myong bya myong byed thams cad bden par ma grub la/ snang grags kyi chos gang yang bden par grub pa mi srid mod kyi/ brtag pa mthar bzung ste ci ste bden grub kyi sdug bsngal zhig srid du chug kyang*/ bden med kyi sdug bsngal myong ba 'di las lhag po'i sdug bsngal myong rgyu med/

'di med par rtogs na rang grol du 'dug pa la de ltar ma rtogs pa snying re rje zhes yang yang bsam zhing bsgom/ dmigs skor drug cu re bzhi pa'o// //da ni de'i bogs 'don du zhag gcig stong nyid 'ba' zhig bsgom/ zhag gcig snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom/ zhag gcig sngar gyi stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug de bsgom/ de 'dra yang yang byas pas bogs cig thon nas 'ong*/ yang res 'ga' thun gcig stong nyid rkyang pa bsgom/ thun gcig snying rje rkyang ba bsgom/ thun gcig gam gnyis la stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug bsgom/ de ltar skabs skabs su yang yang byas pas kyang bogs cig thon nas yong thun gcig go /da 'di la gegs sel gyi tha snyad gsung bar gda'/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'brel de sgom gyi mthil yin/ de la tshe 'di'i bde ba la zhen pa'i gegs 'byung ste/ tshe 'dir longs spyod che ba dang*/ gtam snyan pa dang*/ kha drag pa cig 'dod dam/ mi gzhan rnams kyis kyang chos pa bzang por 'dzin du re/ gzhan pas rang lhag pa cig yong du re/ snying nas 'dod zhen ma log par gzhan sun 'byin pa'i phyir dang*/ rang phyogs 'khyongs pa'i phyir du bya btang byed/ chig ri'am/ 'dag sbyar ram/ dka' thub bam/ ldum bu'am/ lto 'dod kyi btsun pa/ grags phyir gyi bsnyen rdzogs/ khengs dregs kyi tshul 'chos/ phugs mi thams cad rang la dad pa skyes te/ rang rgyal ba cig yong du re bas 'phral pham kha len pa ltar byed pa sogs kyang chos la snyad nas 'jig rten gyi che thabs sgrub par gda'/ stong nyid snying rje dang rgyab 'gal yin/ de dag dug dang 'dres pa'i zas bya ba lags/ thog ma nyid nas 'jig rten phal pa bzhin du bsam pa dang :spyod pa [sbyor ba ]gnyis dkar nag rkyang du song ba de ches smad pa gzhir bzhag mod kyang*/ de la dge sbyor dang 'dres pa ltar bzang rdzu'i yul du yang ma byung*/ de rnams kyi gnyen por skyes bu chung ngu'i bsam pa yang yang dran dgos/

phyi ma lha mi'i bde ba la zhen pa'i gegs bya ba/ 'khor ba'i bde ba la sred pa ma log pas sbyin pa 'dra gtong*/ tshul khrims 'dra srung*/ khrigs chags kyi dge sbyor bag re byed kyang skye ba phyi ma'i zas gos longs spyod gnas khang*/ bu smad 'khor g.yog dbang thang 'dzoms pas skyid pa cig ka smon na/ stong nyid snying rje'i mi mthun phyogs su song*/ de'i gnyen por skyes bu 'bring gi bsam pa rnams bskyar gyin bsgom dgos/ blo chos su song yang rang don yid byed kho na 'dug na stong nyid snying rje dang rgyab 'gal yin pas/ de'i gnyen por bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba bsgom dgos/ de yang go yul tsam la ma lus pa'i rang g-i lus sems kyi thog tu dmigs gtad khel nges shes pa gal che/ de'i gdams ngag blo sbyong na gsal/ spyod 'jug dang bslab btus kun na yang rgyas par yod/ rgyal tshab byams pas/ bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa'i sems nyid dam/ / bdag pas gzhan gces sdug pa rnyed nas ni/ /de ltar bdag pas gzhan don mchog tu shes/ /rang gi don gang gzhan gyi don gang yin/ /zhes gsungs/ stong nyid sgom pa'i go yul yang yang byas kyang bden par med do/ /sgyu ma lta bu'o bya ba de yal yul du song nas gnad du ma 'byor/ dgra gnyen longs spyod gtam sogs kyi rnam rtog rags pa de ka 'dug na/ stong nyid snying rje'i m-i mthun phyogs yin pas rang gi lus sems rdzas yo byad dgra gnyen rnams kyi steng du/ sgyu ma lta bu'i blo de khel nges shes pa snying thag pa nas sbyong ba gal che/ de yang thun gcig go /yang dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ las rgyu 'bras/ chos la dad pa/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems/ bdag med gnyis bsgom pa rnams zhag re'am thun re'i nang du res 'ga' bstar chags su bsgom/ res 'ga' lugs zlog tu bsgom/ res 'ga' rkang 'thon du bsgom/

res 'ga' dkrugs pa dang 'chol bar bsgom/ res 'ga' sems la gang gnod pa'i spang bya shas che ba de'i steng du bsgom/ res 'ga' 'di sgom bde bar 'dug snyam pa de bsgom/ 'di yang thun gcig go /rgyun gyi nyams len la mi rtag pa dur dur dran pa dang*/ las 'bras kyi don bsam pa'i 'dzem bag dang*/ khams gsum 'khor ba thams cad la snying rje dang*/ spros bral gyi gnas lugs la mnyam par 'jog pa ste bzhi po 'di gtso bor bsgom/ gzhan rnams 'khor gyi tshul du bsgom mo/ /chos 'di spyod pa'i bla ma dam pa'am grogs bzang po dang 'grogs/ thun mtshams su mdo sde rnams klog pa'am nyan pas kyang sgom gyi bogs 'byin chos la nges pa rnyed dad par gsos 'debs pa yin/ khyad par bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung bstan rim dang 'brel ba'i be'u bum re la'ang*/ lta rtog dang nan chags dang don sems thog tu 'jog pa kho na gnad du che ba lags/ 'di la'ang thun gcig ste/ phyi ma bzhi bo 'di rgyun gyi nyams len dang gegs sel bogs 'don la slob pa yin/ dmigs skor du bcad ni mi dgos/ yang dmigs skor du byas kyang 'gal ba med do// //rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa/ de las 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub 'grub tshul ni/ rgyas par gzhung lugs chen po rnams nyan pas go bar 'gyur/ 'dir bshad kyis yang mi lang ba lags/ snying po ni ji skad du/ slob dpon 'phags pas/ tshul khrims sbyin pa gzhan gyi don/ /brtson 'grus bzod pa bdag nyid kyi/ /bsam gtan shes rab thar ba'i rgyu/ /snying rje bas ni don kun 'grub/ /ces dang*/ bdun po 'di dag ma lus par/ /gcig car pha rol phyin pa yis/ /ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab yul/ /'jig rten mgon po nyid 'thob 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin te bsam pa byang chub kyi sems dang*/ spyod pa sbyin sogs drug la sbyangs pas rang shugs kyi chos las gzhan du blo mi 'gro zhing*/

dkon mchog la dad pa dang las 'bras la 'dzem bag dang 'khor ba la skyo shas rnams ngang gis skye/ chos rtse gcig tu bsgom pa la sun pa med par spro ba ngang gis 'phel na/ ting nge 'dzin brtan po skyes rung ma skyes rung lam sna zin pa dang tshogs lam chung ngu rgyud la skyes pa yin no/ /de nas tshogs lam du mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa bdag med kyi don la gsal snang cung zad rnyed pa ni/ byis pa nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan zhes bya'o/ /de nas bsgoms pa'i stobs dang tshogs bsags pa'i stobs gnyis 'dzoms pa las/ gzugs ni lbu ba rdos pa 'dra/ /zhes sogs ltar phung po lnga sgyu ma ltar rtogs shing chos kyi bdag med la gsal snang rim pas rnyed pa ni/ don rab 'byed pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya'o/ /mthong lam nas brtsams te byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu la/ spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes skyes pa ni/ de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan zhes bya'o/ /sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i bsam gtan cha phra ba tsam yod la/ sa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa rnams la/ chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po dag yod do/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar ni de bzhin gshegs pa dge ba'i bsam gtan mthar thug pa yod de/ bsam gtan bzhi pa 'di ni snying po mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes te rgyas par gzhan du rtogs par bya'o/ /bsam gtan bzhi po 'di gong ma'i yi ge na ma bris kyang mdo nas 'byung ba ltar bkod pa yin no/ /dang por lam sna ma zin gyi bar du cung dka' ba yin pas bya ba gzhan thams cad bor la gcig tu 'bad pa gal che/ de nas kyang 'bad rtsol gong 'phel du gtong dgos mod kyi cung zad bla bar 'ong*/ tshogs sgo du ma nas bsags smon lam phyogs sna tshogs nas btab ste/ rgyud sbyangs pas sbyor lam gyi ye shes skyes pa na rang shugs kyis gong 'phel du 'gro zhing 'jug pa bde ba yin/

der yang bdud kyi las phra mo spong ba dang gegs sel ba dang bogs dbyung ba mang du dgos par yod/ de nas rim pas chos nyid mngon gsum du rtogs pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur te/ de nas bde ba nas bde bar spyod pa 'ba' zhig go /'bras bu sangs rgyas ni ngo bo nyid sku rang bzhin 'od gsal spros bral gyi ye shes dang*/ longs sku 'og min du dag pa'i 'khor la chos 'khor mthar thug bskor ba po dang*/ sprul pa'i sku ma dag pa'i zhing rnams su gang la gang 'dul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang*/ 'phrin las ni mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas/ sems can thams cad skal ba dang 'tshams par phan pa dang bde ba bla na med pa la 'god pa'o// 'di la thun gyi nges pa med la ji ltar 'tshams par bshad par bya'o/ /des bstan pa la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i khrid legs par tshar ro// //da ni grub 'bras sems bskyed dang*/ byang sdom len pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ de la gnyis/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang*/ byang sdom gyi cho ga'o/ / dang po ni/ rten dang mchod pa bshams maṇḍal phul te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang slob dpon gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/ de nas dgongs gsol gong bzhin la bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams gyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa'i rjes bzlos lan gsum bya/ skyabs 'gro re re bzhin dgongs gsol re byed pa de rgyas pa'i lugs yin/ bsdus na 'di tsam gyis chog /bar 'dir bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya ste tshogs bsags pa'o/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni dgongs gsol gong dang 'dra/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gis bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas gzung nas/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi ste/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos byar gzhug/ smon sems kyi bslab bya gong du bshad pa rnams las ci rigs pa'am rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bshad/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa chos bdun pa zhes bya ba'i mdo dang*/ sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa'i mdo nas bslab bya dang phan yon du ma 'byung ba rnams rgyas par mdo sde de dag las shes par bya'o zhes brjod/

de nas smon lam ji ltar 'os pa gdab cing*/ bsdu na dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /zhes sogs brjod/ slar yang dkon mchog mchod/ slob dpon la yon dbul/ 'di ni sems bskyed kyi cho gar grags pa smon sems kyi cho ga ste/ 'di la snod brtag pa dang so thar rigs brgyad sngon du 'gro ba sogs gang yang mi dgos pas/ don du gnyer ba thams cad la sbyin du rung ngo*/ /'di ni byams pa nas brgyud pa'i sems bskyed de/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i sems bskyed kyi cho ga logs pa zhig 'phags yul na yod par grags la/ de ni dkon brtsegs kyi nang gi 'di ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod ces bya ba'i mdo logs pa zhig las bsdus pa ste/ de'i dgongs don phyogs 'dir yod pa dpal ldan a ti shas mdzad pa'i/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga na gsal bar bzhugs pa bzhin bkod pa yin no// //gnyis pa byang sdom len pa'i cho ga ni/ rab tu byang chub sems dpa'i bslab gzhi rgyas par ston pa ni theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rnams yin pas mdo sde mang du thos par bya/ yang na byang chub sems dpa'i sa'am/ bslab pa kun las btus pa lta bu nyan na'ang*/ theg chen kun gyi snying po 'dus pa yin pas shin tu legs/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin nam nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo lta bu cig gi bklags lung tsam ma mtha' yang nges par thob par bya'o/ /sngar bstan rim gyi khrid zhib par bskyangs pas kyang theg chen gyi snying po thos pa yin mod kyi/ rjod byed tshig gi sgo nas theg chen gyi mdo sde gcig ma thos pa'i thabs med/ de nas byang sdom blang ba dngos ni/ rten gsum gyi drung du mchod pa bshams/ slob dpon la lan gsum du phyag byas nas thal mo sbyar te/ slob dpon khyod las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag pa len par 'tshal gyi/ de la gnod pa ma mchis na/

bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad cig gsan cing stsal ba'i rigs so/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab dgos te/ tshig de blo la yod na slob ma nyid kyis gsol ba gdab/ de min slob dpon nam grogs kyis rjes bzlos bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig khyod 'di ltar sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod dam/ slob mas kyang 'dod lags zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces bya ste/ de la khyod kyis sems bskyed pa brtan pa dang y-i dam brtan par bya'o zhes dang*/ gzhan dang 'gran pa'i ched du ma yin nam/ ma lags/ gzhan gyi nan gyis len du bcug pa ma yin nam/ ma lags/ zhes dri ba dang lan bya/ de nas mchod yon phal cher la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad kyis mchod pa rnams 'bul/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pas bstod cing phyag kyang phul/ de nas slob dpon la gus pa dang bcas pas bskul ma'i gsol gdab ni 'di skad ces/ slob dpon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa bdag la myur du stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ ming 'di zhes bya ba'am/ rigs kyi bu khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ des kyang yin lags/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ btab lags/ de nas dngos gzhi ni slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims de dag ci bdag las len par 'dod dam/ de ltar len par 'tshal lo/ /de nas cho ga dngos gzhi ni slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/

tshe dang ldan pa'am rigs kyi bu ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na da ltar bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir 'gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi gang dag dang*/ tshul khrims gang dag la/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs par gyur pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad slob par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu dag na da ltar bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob bzhin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims nga las nod dam/ zhes dris pa la/ slob mas rab tu len lags so/ /de ltar lan gsum brjod pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye ba yin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ rigs ky-i bu byang chub sems dpa'i ming 'di zhes bya ba'i/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar bya ba lan gsum gyi bar du yang dag par mnos lags te/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba 'dis/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dpang por gyur pas/ 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur kyang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mthas gtugs pa'i chos thams cad lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo/

/zhes lan gsum mo/ /'di slob dpon langs te phyogs bcur me tog gtor nas thal mo sbyar te 'don par snang ngo*/ /de nas slob mas dkon mchog dang*/ slob dpon la phyag gsum gsum byas te yang 'dug pa la 'di skad ces khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bu dang spun zla'i dgongs pa mdzad de rtag tu srung zhing skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa 'di/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la mi smra zhing gsang ba gal che/ deng phyin chad phas pham pa bzhi'am brgyad/ nyes byas bzhi bcu zhe drug la sogs pa rtag tu spangs bar bya/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims srung ba'i thabs dang*/ ltung ba yang lci'i khyad par dang*/ de dag phyir bcos pa la yang mkhas par bya'o zhes brjod/ rgyas pa la spro na bslab bya rags rim tsam skabs 'dir brjod na'ang legs so/ /spyir byang sdom len pa'i lugs 'di la/ bslab bya rnams sngon du nges par byas nas sdom pa phyis len pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir ma brjod kyang cho ga'i yan lag nyams pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ro/ /de rjes yon phul dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /des byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga legs par song*/ bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa'am/ skyes bu gsum gyi khrid bskyangs pa'i grub 'bras/ sems bskyed lag len dang bcas pa tshar ba lags/ chos 'dod pa gang zhig mdo lugs kho na la mos na/ mdo'i nyams len thams cad 'dir 'dus shing*/ deng sang gi mdo lugs pa gzhan la med pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' babs dang ldan pa yin pas/ chos 'di nyid nyams len gyi gtso bor byed dgos la/ sngags la mos pa rnams kyang 'di la ma zhugs na gsang sngags log par 'gro nyen yod pas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi bzhed gzhung 'di la legs par 'dod pa thams cad ky-is bslab par bya'o//

//thugs rje'i dbang phyug rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyal tshab dam pa rgyal sras mi pham mgon/ /chos kun bdag po 'phags pa thogs med zhabs/ / kun mkhyen gnyis pa rgyal sras dbyig gnyen la/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi'o gsol ba 'debs/ /mchog sde la sogs gser gling rgyal po'i bar/ /rgya chen spyod brgyud bla ma mchog rnams dang*/ /rgyal sras 'jam dpal 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs/ /zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa mchog rnams dang*/ /gsang bdag rnal 'byor ma dpal tilli sogs/ /nyams len byin rlabs brgyud pa mchog rnams la/ /gus pas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs mnga' a ti sha /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas 'brom ston rin po che/ /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas po to ba/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mthar son shar ba pa/ /chos bzhin spyod mdzad gtum ston blo gros grags/ /bka' gdams bstan pa'i srog shing rdo ston pa/ /ye shes gzi 'od 'bar pa'i dpal ldan gro/ /bslab gsum rnam dag skyo ston seṅge skyabs/ /che dgu'i gtsug rgyan mchims chen nam mkha' grags/ /nus mthu'i mnga' bdag smon lam tshul khrims zhabs/ /'gro don dpag med ze'u grags pa'i mtshan/ /chos mngon rgya mtsho'i mthar son blo bzang mchims/ /rnam dag thugs mnga' gro ston kun rgyal ba/ /grub pa shes rab spang ston chos kyi rje/ /blo mchog dam pa bson nams mchog grub dang*/ /zab don srol 'dzin dpal ldan don grub zhabs/ /thugs kyis sras gyur gnas brtan bsod nams grags/ /byang chub thugs ldan kun dga' mchog grub zhabs/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo grol mchog rje/ /skye med don gzigs lung rigs rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /yang na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi rjes su/ tshul khrims ye shes 'bar ba'i spyan mnga' ba/

/bla ma dam pas byin brlabs bya yul ba/ /gnas lugs mngon gyur gtsang ba rin po che/ /gdams ngag rgya mtsho'i mthar son mus sman pa/ /de rjes dpal ldan gro nas mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub gyi bar gong bzhin/ de nas/ yon tan mchog gyur mkhan chen kun rgyal ba/ /mkhyen rab rnam dag ye shes rin chen dang*/ /brtson pas rtse gcig sgrub mdzad lha chung ba/ /byams pa'i mtshan can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gzhan yang sne zur ba nas brgyud pa sogs brgyud pa mi 'dra ba mang du bzhugs pas ji ltar sbyar kyang chog la/ gzhung gdams ngag gnyis kyi brgyud pa'i rkang gong du bshad pa nyid gtso bor bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces bya ste/ dad pa rnam dag skyes bu chung ngu'i lam/ /nges 'byung rnam dag skyes bu 'bring gi lam/ /lhag bsam rnam dag skyes bu chen po'i lam/ /rnam dag lam gsum thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba rgyud la ma skyes na/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang tshe 'di'i kha 'dzin can/ /rang blo chos su 'gro skabs mi 'dug pas/ /chos brgyad 'ching ba grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /las 'bras bslu med yid ches ma skyes na/ /chos spyod thams cad bzang rdzu'i ngang du 'chor/ /sgrub pa lhur len skad kyang gzhan ngor thal/ /chos la yid ches skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /byams dang snying rje rgyud la ma skyes na/ /sgrub la brtson yang theg pa dman par gol/ /'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal khur khyer nas/ /byang chub sems mchog 'byongs bar byin gyis rlobs/ /spros kun rang grol stong nyid ma rtogs na/ /chos kun sgyu ma lta bur mi shes shing*/ /mtshan 'dzin dbang song rang sems mi grol bas/ /gnas lugs mthar thugs rtogs par byin gyis brlobs/ / zhes gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /bdag gis chos skor 'dir gtogs pa la/ lam sgron rtsa 'grel/ bden gnyis rtsa 'grel/

dbu ma'i man ngag rtsa 'grel gyi bshad pa/ mus sman pa'i 'khrid yig /lum pa ba'i lam rim/ po to pa'i dpe chos rtsa 'grel rnams mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub las thos/ po to ba'i be'u bum rtsa 'grel dang snar thang pa'i lam mchog rtsa 'grel/ mchims kyi gsung rgyun 'khrid yig gi lung rnams dang bstan rim gyi 'khrid tshul rgyas pa gsung ngag nas nyams khrid kyi tshul du mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho las thos so/ /thor bu thor bu dam pa gzhan 'ga' zhig las kyang thos mod kyi/ chos skor 'di la brgyud pa'i gtso bo gong du smos pa nyid yin no/ /rgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi dgongs pa 'di/ /mdo tsam bris las bsod nams gang yod des/ /ma lus lus pa med pa'i sems can rnams/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i gong 'phang myur thob shog /bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa/ skyes bu gsum gyi man ngag gi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o/ /'di ni sgom tshul dmigs pa'i khrid yig yin la/ go don blo la 'god pa'i bshad pa ni/ dam pa snga ma rnams kyis mdzad pa las btsal bar bya'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /zhus dag /bkra shis/

lhag bsam dge bas rab dkar bsod nams 'dis/ / rtsa ba'i bla ma dgyes byed mchod sprin dang*/ /bdag gzhan sgrib sbyang tshogs chen rab rdzogs nas/ /don gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal yon myur spyod shog /ces pa'i bsngo smon nyer bsdus 'di chos mched gu ṇa bha dra nyid la mkho phyir ma tis brisapa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/skyes bu gsum gyi man ngag gi khrid yig bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 226 -- PAGE 325 -- PAGE 225 -
